verdict.rationale: Deepgram's Voice Agent is itself a documented public API: a single WebSocket endpoint (wss://.../v1/agent/converse, with regional EU, AU and India variants) that runs the whole conversation. It also documents mid-call control messages such as InjectAgentMessage and a Console API for reusable agent configurations, and a probe confirmed a live OpenAPI spec at openapi.json. SDK quickstarts in Python, JavaScript, C# and Go, plus token-based authentication, round out programmatic access. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the agent end-to-end via the API (the evidence is vendor docs and endpoint probes only).
